name: sol8-contract-metadata
goal: Show requiredness, exact defaults, errors and returns in every contract view

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Review item 44: all three contract views omit per-input requirement and default metadata; callable error absence is hidden.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend existing entity-contract SSR, desktop contract-panel SSR and component-catalog assertions; retain case titles and all three viewports, add exact defaults and metadata fit checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen checkpoint 74467bc5bc fails nine default-view cases on missing input metadata; record 3bea063405a5 retains all nine captures. Unit checks independently fail the missing fields.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 407f1ab711 retains required/default metadata through Reports and Desktop types and projections, renders metadata and explicit error absence, and stacks fields through tablet width.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged frozen browser command passes all nine cases at 407f1ab711; record 207bc0dc239c retains all captures. Reports 16/16 and Desktop 2/2 focused unit checks pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
